payload.core_mechanism_summary: Graph built with parity constraints (edges=popcount parity % 2). BFS/DFS assigns node parities and checks contradiction. If consistent, assign missing edge values.
payload.rationale: The solution propagates parity constraints via graph traversal, which is exactly a BFS/DFS for bipartite consistency on XOR equations. Bit operations are minimal, only used to get parity of popcount.
